newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market is closed on Wednesday for the New Year holiday. The market re-opens on January 2.
On Tuesday, the Malaysian rubber market had a half-day of trading, with prices ending unchanged from Monday.
At the close, January RSS1 buyer and SMR 20 buyer were quoted at 316 cents ($1.25) and 310 cents ($1.23) a kg respectively by the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board.
